seedMemories: Story day 1 (a Sunday morning about twelve days before Dhanteras): {{playerName}}, home from Delhi for the Diwali holidays, is running his family's shop, Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar, for the first time because Papa has a back injury.
A monkey stole a box of ghewar (Sharma aunty's order) from Mishri Agarwal and dropped it on {{playerName}}'s counter in front of the whole lane.
Mishri recognised {{playerName}} instantly as her childhood rooftop friend — 'chhat wale, neele kanche wale' — and whispered that his family's ghewar is sweeter than hers.
Rajendra Agarwal, Mishri's father, ordered her back and declared that the Agarwals never touch anything the Laxmi family has touched. The families have been feuding for twelve years.

Dadi Kamla Devi looked at Mishri with unexpected softness, then mentioned Mishri's rishta with a London boy whose family arrives on Dhanteras. Mishri walked away without smiling; a mogra flower from her braid fell on {{playerName}}'s counter.
The Mithai Mahotsav sweet competition is on Dhanteras; Agarwal Sweets has won three years running.
